solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Father's put in lock — to prevent this?

definitions.text: Father's put in lock — to prevent this?

indicators.note: put in tells us the father's word is placed inside the lock word

parts.note: a lock of hair is a tress
father is PA, and the possessive adds S

explanation.surface: Someone fits a lock on the door, and the clue asks what it is meant to keep out.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole, the clue both builds the answer and describes it: a lock on a gate is there to keep intruders off your land.
explanation.definitionFit: Locks exist to stop people entering property without permission, which is the offence named.

clue.text: Course not permitted in religious studies

indicators.note: in places the words for not permitted inside the abbreviation for the school subject

parts.note: RE is Religious Education, the school subject
in sport, a ball that is out is not permitted or in play

explanation.surface: A school course that is banned from the religious studies syllabus.
explanation.definitionFit: A course is a path or way taken from one place to another, a synonym.

clue.text: Understanding town's upset about the map being redrawn

indicators.note: about says the reversed town's word wraps around the rearranged letters
upset in a down clue means the word for town's is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: a town is a city, plus the possessive S

indicators.note: being redrawn means the letters of the map are drawn again in a new order

explanation.surface: A town is upset when its map is redrawn, and someone is sympathetic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' is the reversal signal, as this is a down clue; 'being redrawn' scrambles the map, and 'about' wraps the reversed town around that.
explanation.definitionFit: An understanding person is compassionate and feels for others, a synonym.

clue.text: Food allowed in summer month excludes nothing served with cheese?

parts.note: AUG is the abbreviation for August, a summer month

indicators.note: excludes means the letter for nothing is left out of the food word

parts.note: a ration is the amount of food allowed to each person
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A ration of food in August that excludes nothing, perhaps served with cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excludes' drops the zero-shaped letter. The French cooking term means topped with browned breadcrumbs or grated cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish described this way is finished with a crust of grated cheese, hence served with cheese.

clue.text: Absolute limit wrongly put in trio sonata

indicators.note: wrongly says these letters are set out incorrectly and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Somebody has wrongly inserted something into a trio sonata, a piece for three instruments.
explanation.definitionFit: The point beyond which nothing more can be absorbed is an idiom for the absolute limit.

clue.text: Ring not new? Bloke disheartened girl

indicators.note: not says the letter for new is left out of the word for ring

parts.note: to ring someone is to phone them

indicators.note: disheartened means the heart, the middle letters, of bloke is removed, leaving its two ends

explanation.surface: A disheartened bloke asks whether the ring is not new, perhaps an engagement ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Phoebe is a girl's name, so it fits the definition as an example.

clue.text: French bread I used when going about Northern Italian sandwiches

indicators.note: going about means the bread word goes around the letter for Northern

parts.note: pain is the French word for bread

explanation.surface: French bread is pressed into service for northern Italian sandwiches.
explanation.definitionFit: These are grilled Italian sandwiches; the word is the Italian plural of a bread roll.

clue.text: Fuel line is operating at first after set-up

indicators.note: set-up in a down clue says the letters are put up, read from the bottom
at first takes the opening letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: A fuel line is working at first, once the system has been set up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first' gives L, I, O; 'set-up' turns them upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Petroleum products burnt in engines and heaters are a common fuel.

clue.text: Biblical seductress has sneakily to ensnare Hebrew after flutter of eyelid

parts.note: to bat an eyelid is to flutter it

indicators.note: to ensnare means to trap within, so the rearranged letters surround the Hebrew abbreviation
sneakily signals the letters of has are moved about by stealth

parts.note: HEB is the abbreviation for Hebrew

explanation.surface: A biblical temptress sneakily traps a Hebrew man with the flutter of an eyelid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sneakily' scrambles the small word, 'to ensnare' wraps it round the abbreviation, and 'after' puts the eyelid flutter first. In the Bible, King David saw her bathing and took her.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the woman in the Book of Samuel whose beauty seduced King David.

clue.text: Spice fanatic turned over excellent specimen

parts.note: a fanatic is a nut, as in a fitness nut

indicators.note: turned over means the word for an excellent specimen is flipped and read backwards

parts.note: a gem is something excellent of its kind

explanation.surface: A fanatic turns over a fine specimen of some spice.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of a tropical tree, grated as a spice for cooking.

clue.text: Theater award involving a literary key

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the award wraps round the other letters

parts.note: the Tony is the Broadway theatre award
LIT is short for literary or literature

explanation.surface: A theatre award for a literary drama is presented as the key to its success.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the key of a piece is its tonal centre, a synonym.

clue.text: Cheese — lot getting consumed a different way?

indicators.note: a different way says the word for consumed inside the lot word is turned to face the other direction

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate or destiny
consumed means ate, as in eaten up

explanation.surface: A lot of cheese gets eaten in a different way.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for consumed sits inside the word for lot; 'a different way' turns just that part round, leaving the first letter in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A crumbly white Greek cheese made from sheep's or goat's milk.

clue.text: Expert on land, dodgy at moorings

indicators.note: dodgy means unsound or unreliable, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A land expert is nervous about the boats at their moorings.
explanation.definitionFit: This specialist studies soil management and crop production, so is an expert on farmland.

clue.text: Officer left, not entirely keen about United in group of teams

parts.note: a major is an army officer

indicators.note: about means the trimmed keen word goes around the letter for United
not entirely means the last letter is dropped from the word for keen

parts.note: keen means eager
U is the abbreviation for United, as in football team names

explanation.surface: An officer has left, not entirely keen on United's place in their league.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' cuts EAGER to EAGE; 'about' places U inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: In US sport this is the top professional division, a group of teams.

clue.text: Lean on women's organisation quietly to produce what's hoped for?

indicators.note: on in an across clue means placed after, so the lean word follows

parts.note: WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation
SH is the call to be quiet
to lean is to list, as a ship does

explanation.surface: Someone leans quietly on the Women's Institute to get what they want.
explanation.walkthrough: The WI is the Women's Institute, a British community organisation for women.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of things one would like to have is a set of things hoped for.

clue.text: Initial repetition, not all repetition

indicators.note: not means the following word is taken away from the poetic device

parts.note: alliteration is the repetition of initial sounds in neighbouring words
taken as written

explanation.surface: A writer's tic of repeating opening sounds, though not quite all repetition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initial repetition' is a cryptic description of a device like 'Peter Piper picked'; take away 'all' from the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing or saying something again is a synonym of repeating it, especially in computing loops.

clue.text: Comedian avoiding limits of strident mockery

indicators.note: avoiding says the letters chosen from strident are kept out of the comedian word

parts.note: a jester is a comedian at court

indicators.note: limits of picks the outside letters of strident

explanation.surface: A comedian steers clear of strident mockery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'limits of strident' gives S and T, which come out of JESTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Derisive shouting is a form of mockery, a synonym.

clue.text: Don't go and stop some cricket

parts.note: to stop somewhere is to stay there
an over is a set of six balls in cricket

explanation.surface: A plea not to leave and to stay for some cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: An over is a set of six deliveries bowled from one end in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain somewhere overnight rather than leave is the opposite of going.

clue.text: Satisfied about article providing essential material

indicators.note: about means the word for satisfied goes around the article

parts.note: to have met demands is to have satisfied them
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone is satisfied about an article that provides key material.
explanation.definitionFit: The substance or core of a thing, as in the meat of an argument.

clue.text: After switching components, escape epidemic

indicators.note: switching components means the two parts of the word for escape trade places

parts.note: a breakout is an escape from prison

explanation.surface: After parts are swapped, an escape from an epidemic.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden start of disease spreading is a synonym for an epidemic.

clue.text: Fixes to tour US city and Midwest feature

indicators.note: to tour means to go around, so the fixes word surrounds the city

parts.note: pins fix things in place
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: Someone fixes a tour of an American city and a Midwest landmark.
explanation.definitionFit: The Great Plains are the flat grasslands that characterise the American Midwest, so an example.

clue.text: Strangely no opening for cricket players getting out too often?

indicators.note: strangely signals the letters appear in an odd order
opening for takes the first letter of cricket

explanation.surface: Cricket batsmen who strangely have no opening and keep getting out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting out' sounds like a batsman's dismissal, but here it is dropping out of consciousness.
explanation.definitionFit: This sleep disorder makes people nod off, conking out, far too often.

clue.text: Go for no fine work on metal?

indicators.note: no means the letter for fine is absent from the fetching word

parts.note: to go for something is to fetch it
F is the pencil abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Go for no fine metalwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Engraving a design with acid is how one works on a metal plate.

clue.text: Exclamation over trap taking tail off dog

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the exclamation above the next part

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise

indicators.note: taking tail off means the last letter is removed from the trap word

parts.note: a gin is a snare or trap

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims at a trap that has taken the tail off a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: Cor is everyday British slang for wow.
explanation.definitionFit: A short-legged Welsh breed favoured by the British royal family, an example of a dog.

clue.text: Finally you will tuck into fish in foremost of Italian pasta

indicators.note: will tuck into means the chosen letter is pushed inside the other letters

parts.note: ling is a type of fish

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of you
foremost of takes the first letter of Italian

explanation.surface: You eat fish at last, in the finest Italian pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will tuck into' places the last letter of you between the fish and 'in'; 'foremost of' then adds the Italian initial.
explanation.definitionFit: Long flat ribbons of noodle are an Italian pasta, an example.

clue.text: Bit of latex taken from blue tree

indicators.note: taken from means the chosen letter is removed from the blue word

parts.note: blue means depressed or glum

indicators.note: bit of takes the first letter of latex

explanation.surface: Some latex is taken from a blue tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bit of latex' gives L, which comes out of GLUM. The eucalyptus is called a gum tree in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: The eucalyptus is known as a gum, named for its sticky sap, so the word names a tree.

clue.text: Fancy a grand change will come about

indicators.note: will come about means the change word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: to vary is to change
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A grand change will come about, someone fancies.
explanation.definitionFit: A whim or caprice, a sudden fancy, is a synonym.

clue.text: Essence in article recalled acrimony

indicators.note: recalled means called back, read in the reverse direction

parts.note: the sum of something is its gist or essence
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: The essence of an article is recalled with acrimony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns the whole three-part string round, not just the essence.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostility or ill will towards someone is a synonym for acrimony.

clue.text: Reduced opportunity to get Central America spice

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the last letter of the opportunity word goes

parts.note: a turn is a chance or opportunity

indicators.note: central takes the middle letters of America

explanation.surface: Reduced opportunity to get spice from Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow root powder used in curries is an example of a spice.
